retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white portrait featuring a subject against a repetitive geometric pattern with boxed, minimalist sans-serif typography in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white photography with boxed text

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up black and white portrait of a man with intense eyes, wearing an ornate embroidered jacket, set against a background of repeating diamond and dot patterns. The composition is anchored by a small, rectangular text block in the top right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark clothing contrasts sharply with the light geometric background
Intricate embroidery on the jacket mirrors the complexity of the background pattern
The subject's direct gaze creates a strong psychological connection with the viewer
The small, rigid text box provides a modern, graphic counterpoint to the organic portrait
coreInvariants: Strict black and white grayscale palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the high-contrast facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the ornate jacket details, then up to the geometric background and finally to the boxed text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with pattern and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks in the subject's hair and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites in the background and highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the skin texture and jacket embroidery.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from pure black to pure white.

letterConstructionRules: Contained within a thin-bordered rectangular box

treatment.outline: Thin white border around black box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different weights or sizes within a boxed graphic device.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line between text lines

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, 80s-modernist feel of the original.
Provides a sturdy, industrial sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with dark hair and intense eyes, wearing a black jacket with intricate silver/white embroidery. The background should be a repeating pattern of diamonds with central dots.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small rectangular black box in the top right corner with a thin white border. Inside, place two lines of white, all-caps geometric sans-serif text separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the background a consistent geometric pattern?
Is the text contained within a bordered box in the corner?
Is the subject's gaze direct and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Specific text content in the box

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's face
Precise alignment of the graphic text box
avoid: Muddy gray tones with no true blacks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present
Verify the geometric pattern is seamless
Check that the text box border is crisp
Confirm the lighting creates dramatic shadows on the face
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + geometric lattice background + ornate fashion + boxed geometric sans-serif typography.
